extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server, at whatever speed you like. Playback speed is adjustable per book with pitch correction, progress syncs back to the server, and a sleep timer fades out and stops on its own.
extension.news: v1.0.1 Sorting fix. "All Books" claimed to be sorted by title and was not: the default sort key was one AudioBookShelf does not recognise, and an unknown key makes the server return rows in no order rather than reporting a problem. Three other sort options were silently doing nothing for the same reason; Narrator and Series are gone (there is no key for either) and "Recently updated" is now "Recently changed on disk". Added "Recently listened".
